value.rationale: No separate finding demonstrated a real secret or a legal requirement, so no exception to the immutable-history rule applies. Every migration is a tip-level placement change.
value.public_history_statement: Removing material from the default branch does not make earlier public history private. Earlier commits still contain the material that later commits moved, and this cutover does not claim otherwise.
value.review_required_note: The classification manifest marks 53 entries history_treatment=review-required. That flag records that a reviewer looked at whether history treatment was needed; the review concluded none was, and no entry authorizes a rewrite.
